input_contract: Only public problem.json with nine acquisition protocol specifications and six disjoint forecast protocol specifications, plus acquired public observations; no World object or private targets in policy/forecaster process
coverage_rule: Greedy minimize mean nearest standardized generic waveform-feature distance from public held-out forecast protocols; deterministic index tie-break
random_rule: Uniform sample of four distinct shared-pool protocols without replacement using fixed generator seed
forecast_rule: Common public-only ridge regression on eight generic waveform features and acquired spike counts; fixed penalty 1.0, unpenalized intercept, nonnegative predictions
primary_metric: Official floored held-out spike-forecast MSE, computed only after forecasts are frozen, reported per world with no inferential pooling across six designed worlds
purpose: Weak but truth-blind action-selection control and engineering test of sealed forecast scoring; not a mechanistic hypothesis library or foundation-model result
gate: One-world canary must pass exact action cost, public/private hash, prediction count, and scorer parity before remaining five worlds run
forbidden: No world-specific discriminator mapping, upstream truth tables, test target values, Azure, or any closed-source model API in policy or forecaster
